literal: By indication, intention those who understand, among limbs whatever even having given, one should secure.
translation: Secure the service of those who can read another's intention through mere indication, even if it means giving up any of your own limbs or possessions.
modern: ஒருவருடைய முகக் குறிப்பைக் கொண்டே அவருடைய உள்ளக் குறிப்பை அறியும் ஆற்றல் உடையவரை, தம்முடைய உறுப்புகளுள் எதைக் கொடுத்தாவது தமக்குத் துணையாகச் சேர்த்துக் கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the immense value of people who can read minds through subtle non-verbal cues. The phrase 'குறிப்பின் குறிப்பு உணர்வாரை' refers to those who can deduce another's hidden intention simply by observing their outward indications. To secure such a person's service, the text advises giving up 'உறுப்பினுள் யாது' (whatever among one's limbs or possessions). Here, 'உறுப்பு' can mean a physical limb or a vital part of one's wealth, serving as a hyperbole to show that no price is too high for such an advisor.
